news.title: James Handy, Actor in ‘Top Gun: Maverick,’ Is Found Stabbed to Death
news.summary: The 81-year-old actor had parts in films including “Top Gun: Maverick” and “Arachnophobia.” The son of his girlfriend was arrested and charged with murder.
